sents.zh: 今天早上，我一起床就发现天很黑。
sents.en: This morning, the moment I got up I saw the sky was dark.

sents.zh: 过了一点时间，就开始下雨了。
sents.en: A little later it began to rain.

sents.zh: 雨越下越大，所以我不能出去玩。
sents.en: The rain grew heavier, so I could not go out to play.

sents.zh: 我坐在窗前面，看着外面。
sents.en: I sat by the window and looked outside.

sents.zh: 雨打在地上，有很好听的声音。
sents.en: The rain struck the ground with a lovely sound.
People in the street were all walking fast.

sents.zh: 一个小孩跑过去，身上都是水。
sents.en: A child ran past, soaked through.

sents.zh: 我本来觉得有一点没有意思。
sents.en: At first I felt a little bored.
Then I decided to read at home.

sents.zh: 妈妈给我做了一杯热的东西。
sents.en: Mother made me something hot to drink.

sents.zh: 她也拿了一本书，坐在我前面。
sents.en: She took a book too, and sat down in front of me.

sents.zh: 我们两个人都不说话，房间里很好。
sents.en: Neither of us spoke, and the room was pleasant.
By the afternoon the rain slowly eased.

sents.zh: 天亮了一些，外面看起来很干净。
sents.en: The sky brightened a little, and outside looked clean.

sents.zh: 我想，下雨天也有它好的地方。
sents.en: I think a rainy day has its good side too.
